title: Schema Modification: ALTER & DROP
description: Modify existing table structures using ALTER TABLE and remove tables or databases using DROP TABLE.

blocks.content:
To modify table structure after creation:

- `ALTER TABLE table_name ADD COLUMN col_name type;` — adds a new column.
- `DROP TABLE table_name;` — permanently deletes a table and all its data.

The schema is the table’s blueprint. `ALTER` changes the blueprint, while `DROP` removes an object entirely.

Changing a blueprint can affect existing data; dropping is much more serious. Check the target and make a backup before destructive changes.

blocks.prompt: Add a new column `email TEXT` to the `users` table using `ALTER TABLE`, then select all columns from `users`.
blocks.starterCode: -- Alter table users to add email column
blocks.schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT);
blocks.answer_sql: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email TEXT; SELECT * FROM users;
